context.label: Testing and wilderness before Jesus’ encounter

observations.body: Moses tells Israel to remember forty wilderness years. The LORD humbled and tested them, allowed hunger, gave manna, and taught that life depends on every word from his mouth.
observations.label: Forty years, hunger, manna, and every word

observations.label: Israel and the LORD

observations.body: The passage places Forty wilderness years beside Israel and the LORD.
observations.label: Forty wilderness years

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 8:1–5 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states moses tells Israel to remember forty wilderness years. The LORD humbled and tested them, allowed hunger, gave manna, and taught that life depends on every word from his mouth. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the temptation of Jesus.
payload.title: Forty years, hunger, manna, and every word
